Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from this match. West Indies have a chance to level up the series. The second T20I is on Saturday, 13th August at 12 am IST (6.30 pm GMT, previous day). Join us for the build up as well. Goodbye!

Kane Williamson, the captain of New Zealand says that it is nice to get a win and he is pleased with the performance of the team. Says that he is well aware of the hitting ability of the West Indies batters and that they are capable of amazing things. He states that is happy that they managed to secure the win. Says that everyone has a role to play in the team and is happy that he was able to contribute. Says that the cameos towards the end helped them put up a challenging total and the bowlers did well to stay calm and execute their plans well.

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies. He says they did well to take the game till the last over. Says the last over took the game away while Neesham was batting. Says that if they could have restricted them to 175 they were in the game. Says in hindsight it was not an easy pitch as Mitchell Santner and Ish Sodhi bowled really well and there was turn on this wicket. Credits the middle order batter for playing well and getting them close to the total. Mentions Romario Shepherd and Odean Smith for the hitting ability and for keeping them in the game. Once again mentions that had they restricted the opponents to 175 they may have been able to achieve the target. Says the batters made some mistakes and gives Shimron Hetmyer as an example saying that he hit the ball in the air and next time he would probably play along the ground. Continues to say that batters will keep getting better and they are quite confident that things will improve.

Mitchell Santner is the MAN OF THE MATCH. He says it was a good wicket as there was some spin on offer. As a unit, they picked up wickets at regular intervals and that was key. Adds that he played a lot of cricket here, in the Caribbean Premier League at Trinidad and that gives an idea of what kind of length works. Shares that it was key to pick up wickets at regular intervals. On Kane Williamson, it is massive to have him back. He controlled the innings well. Applauds James Neesham's innings as well.
...Presentation coming up...

New Zealand will not be that disappointed. Although they were some fireworks going on in the final phase. New Zealand kept their cool and executed their plans. They did well to pick wickets at regular intervals and even Kane Williamson used his five bowlers really well. Mitchell Santner was the pick of the bowlers as he scalped three wickets. They too just like West Indies put in some wonderful effort on the field. Earlier, New Zealand scored a decent total on a good pitch. Thanks to the innings from Devon Conway and Kane Williamson. The late flourish from James Neesham proved to be the potential match-winning one as they scored 34 in the last two overs. The bowlers were consistent in their lines and did well to not allow any partnerships apart from the last one.

West Indies will feel they left a bit too much for the all-rounders to finish the game. They are still not able to find the best place for their big-hitters. They keep chopping and changing just like we saw them do against India. There is no clear role for the batters other than to go out and go big, which isn't working for them right now. It was something similar in this match, they bat deep and the likes of Jason Holder. Rovman Powell, Romario Shepherd and Odean Smith showed that they have the capabilities. However, in the end it was just too much for the finishers to breach the target.

New Zealand would have had their heart in the mouth looking at the way Odean Smith and Romario Shepherd were batting. The result could have gone either way right till the end. However, the bowlers have done the job and New Zealand lead the 3-match T20I series as they go 1-0 up.
Tim Southee bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Odean Smith works this towards mid-wicket for a single. New Zealand have won this game by 13 runs and go 1-0 up in the series.

James Neesham with some brilliant fielding! Saved his team five runs! Pitched up, on off. Romario Shepherd swings his blade and connected it well. It goes to deep mid-wicket where James Neesham stands at the edge of the ropes and times his jump to pull it back inside the ground. Terrific from James Neesham.

Just two! A slower ball, length and on off. Romario Shepherd again swings across but gets a top egde and over short third man. Lockie Ferguson runs back and does ever so well to keep the ball away from the ropes. Two runs.
SIX! BANG! There is the first one! On a length and on middle. Romario Shepherd clears his front leg and thumps it over long on for a biggie.
Fuller ball, in the slot on off. Smith lost his shape as he swings across and it rolls to long on for a single. 24 needed now.
On a length and on middle. Romario Shepherd looks to pull but gets cramped for room and will only get a single as it rolls to mid-wicket.
FOUR! West Indies still have a small chance! Too full and outside off. Smith powers it through covers and the long off fielder runs across but fails to stop it.
A length ball, outside off. Odean Smith slashes at it but misses. He gets a thick outside edge over backward point but Ish Sodhi does well to track back and keep it down to two.
SIX! West Indies are going down fighting! Lockie Ferguson  bangs this in short and angling into the batter, Odean Smith pulls this wide of deep square leg and deposits this onto the roof!
Short ball outside off bowled slower in the air, Odean Smith looks to pull but gets beaten by the pace.
FOUR! This one reaches the boundary! Another attempted yorker not finding the mark as this is a full toss outside off, Odean Smith thumps this towards deep cover for a boundary.
On a good length and outside off, Romario Shepherd slaps this wide of long on. Mitchell Santner slides and stops the boundary. They get a single.
Straying onto the pads on a fuller length. Hits the pads and rolls towards short fine leg for a leg bye.

SIX! This is proving to be a massive over! Trent Boult goes full and wide outside the off pole. Romario Shepherd reaches for it and swings, loses balance but manages to clear the long off fence by a distance! What hitting from Romario Shepherd!
Slower delivery bowled a fraction short and outside off, Romario Shepherd shapes up for a pull and leaves it at the last moment.
This is full on middle, Romario Shepherd heaves leg side and gets an inside edge towards deep sqaure leg for a brace.

FOUR! This one has edged but gets West Indies another boundary! Trent Boult attempts a yorker but serves a full toss instead. Romario Shepherd swings and gets a thick outside edge that flies to the thrd man fence for a boundary.
SIX! This has been dismissed! Trent Boult serves this a fraction short and outside off, Romario Shepherd swings his arms and hits this straight back over the sight screen for a biggie!
Lockie Ferguson goes full and in line with the stumps, Romario Shepherd clips this towards mid-wicket and takes a run to keep strike.
A fraction short and outside off, Odean Smith mistimes his pull towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower delivery bowled on a length and outside off, Odean Smith swings and misses.

FOUR! Edged and boundary! Lockie Ferguson bowls this almost on a yorker length and angling into the stumps, Odean Smith gets his bat down in time and gets an outside edge that runs to the third man fence for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off. This is bowled slower in the air and Odean Smith leaves this alone. Just inside the tram line.

FOUR! Odean Smith gets off the mark with a boundary! Lockie Ferguson serves this full and outside off, Odean Smith has room to swing his arms and hits this over the mid off fielder. The ball runs to the long off fence for a boundary.
Yorker this time wide outside off, Romario Shepherd looks to dig this out but misses as the ball goes through to the keeper.
Goes full and just outside off, Romario Shepherd fends this back towards the bowler.
Odean Smith is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! Trent Boult bangs this one in short and outside off, Jason Holder goes for the pull and does not time this at all. Gets a top edge that flies towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Glenn Phillips takes an easy catch and Jason Holder has to make the long walk back. West Indies are now seven down.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Trent Boult

Commentary.Commentary: This is full as well and in line with the stumps, Romario Shepherd powers this towards long on and gets a single.
This is full and wide outside off, Jason Holder strokes this towards the cover fielder and they take a quick single.
FOUR! A boundary to start the over! Trent Boult starts with a full toss wide outside off, Jason Holder gets bat to it and works this towards deep point for a boundary.
Trent Boult comes back into the attack.
Tossed up, outside off. Romario Shepherd pushes it to covers. Good stop here. West Indies need 78 more runs in 30 balls.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Romario Shepherd walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! James Neesham gives his name for the contender for the best catch in this match. Sodhi serves it full and way outside off, slows it up. Powell gets on his knee and tries to slog-sweep it but gets a top edge and goes high over point. James Neesham tracks back and has to cover a lot of ground. He keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a superb tumbling catch.
Commentary.Howout: c James Neesham b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: Dropped! Hard one though! Floated ball, full and outside off. Holder uses his feet and tries to go inside-out over covers. Daryl Mitchell runs forward, dives and takes it but spills as he meets the ground. Tries to take on the second attempt but fails so.
Flatter ball, way outside off. Powell cuts it to deep point for a single.
SIX! WOW! MASSIVE! Too full, in the slot and Powell slog-sweeps it over cow corner for a biggie. 100 up for the Windies.
A quick single to end the over. Good comeback from Southee after going for a six. Length ball around off. Powell works it to point for one.
On a length and outside off, cut to point. James Neesham dives to his right and saves a certain boundary.
Around off on a length. Powell drops it to point.
Around off, tucked to mid-wicket. Jason Holder called for two runs but Powell denied the second wisely.
A slower one on a length and on off. Powell tries to nudge it away but gets a leading edge to point for one.
SIX! That is powered away! A length ball, outside off. Powell sees the ball is in his arc and pulls it over square leg for a biggie.
Tim Southee has been handed the ball now. He did take a wicket in his first over but was expensive in his next.
A googly, quicker and on leg. Kept out.
FOUR! Elusive! This is full and outside off. Holder comes down the track and goes inside out over covers for four runs. Need more from Holder.
Short and on the pads. Holder opens his body and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
A googly, flatter and on middle, nudged to square leg for a single.
Fuller ball on middle. Holder eases it to long on for a single.
Flighted full ball, outside off, dragged to deep mid-wicket for one.
Ish Sodhi (2-0-16-0) has been brought back into the attack.
Touch short and on middle. Powell pulls it to deep square leg for a single. A fantastic innings from Mitchell Santner comes to an end.
On middle. Blocked back to the bowler.
Wide! Angles one down the leg side. Powell misses his flick. Mitchell Santner was interested for a while there.

OUT! TAKEN! Shamarh Brooks struggling innings comes to an end! Santner serves it short and around off, it holds onto the surface. Brooks looks to pull but mistimes it to long on where Daryl Mitchell runs forward and kneels to take it.
Commentary.Howout: c Daryl Mitchell b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: Rovman Powell is the new batter out in the middle. He has his work cut out here.
Wide! Flatter and angling outside off but spinning away. Left alone.
SIX! West Indies need more of this from Brooks! Tossed up, around off. Brooks comes down the track and thumps it high and to long on for a biggie. Got good height but enough distance.
This is full and outside off, spinning away. Brooks has a wild swing across but misses. He is struggling a bit.
This one holds on the surface. On the shorter side and outside off, turning away. Holder looks to pull but miscues it completely to long on who runs forward but collects on a bounce.
Lockie Ferguson serves this full and outside off, Shamarh Brooks goes for the expansive drive and gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length and around off. Brooks looks to drive to covers but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Lockie Ferguson bowls a wide yorker and takes some pace off the ball. Shamarh Brooks looks to get bat on this but misses.
Continues bowling back of a length and outside off, Jason Holder mistimes his pull towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Shamarh Brooks guides this towards third man and takes a single.
WIDE! This is short and angling down leg, Shamarh Brooks looks to pull and misses. The umpire calls this wide.
Off-pace delivery, outside off. Brooks looks to push but misses.

Drinks! West Indies are struggling to build a partnership. The required run rate has already crossed 10 and they need these two to score some quick runs. There is no doubt they bat deep but West Indies need someone to take the game till the end. New Zealand will hope to chip in with wickets and keep this game under control.

FOUR! Jason Holder has thumped this one away! Ish Sodhi flights this one once again and temots the batter wide outside off on a fuller length. Jason Holder oblidges and lofts this over the infield as the ball flies towards the deep cover boundary for a much-needed boundary.
Flights this one full and just outside off, Shamarh Brooks goes for a slog and gets an inside edge towards deep square leg for a single.
This is wide outside off and on a fuller length. Jason Holder mistimes his shot towards cover but a misfield from the fielder allows the batters to take a single.
Ish Sodhi flights this one full outside off, Shamarh Brooks gets this to deep cover and takes a run.
Ish Sodhi bowls this short and in line with the stumps, Jason Holder pulls this to deep backward square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, Jason Holder finds the cover fielder with his shot.
Short and wide outside the off pole. Shamarh Brooks cuts and finds the point fielder this time. Just 2 runs of the over.
Quicker delivery, skid off the surface from a fuller length. Shamarh Brooks gets his bat down in time and fends the ball back to the bowler.
Mitchell Santner serves this short as well and outside off, Shamarh Brooks gets this to deep cover-point and takes a couple of runs.
This is short as well and outside off, Shamarh Brooks strokes this straight to the cover fielder.
This is a fraction short and outside off, Shamarh Brooks looks to work this leg side and gets a leading edge towards point.
Mitchell Santner flights the ball full and way outside off, Shamarh Brooks swings and is beaten on the outside edge.
Another wrong 'un to end the over. Serves this full and outside off, Jason Holder defends this back to the bowler.
Flights this one full and outside off stump, Shamarh Brooks heaves towards the offside but manages to slice it towards deep cover-point for a single.
Ish Sodhi fires in a quick googly full and outside off, Shamarh Brooks looks to swing and misses.

Excellent review from Brooks! Sodhi serves it short and angling around leg but the ball doesn't bounce at all and hits Brooks low on the front pad as he was shaping for a big heave across the line. A huge appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Brooks reviews it. He looks confident. No bat there. Ball Tracking shows wickets missing.

SIX! Ish Sodhi bowls a full toss and it gets the full treatment! Flights this one and Shamarh Brooks catches the ball well to deposit this over the long on fence for a maximum! West Indies need many more of these.
Ish Sodhi begins with a googly angling into the stumps, Jason Holder hits the ball towards long on for a single.
Ish Sodhi is into the attack
Serves this full and in line with the stumps, Jason Holder clips the ball towards square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Jason Holder comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! West Indies are digging themselves in a ditch here! Mitchell Santner flights this full outside off, Shimron Hetmyer goes for the lofted sweep but does not get a hold of it. James Neesham at deep backward square leg is perfectly positioned to pouch this. West Indies seem to be losing their way here. Mitchell Santner has his second.
Commentary.Howout: c James Neesham b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: This is full and in line with the stumps, Shamarh Brooks works this wide of long on takes a single.
Mitchell Santner bowls this short and wide outside off, Shamarh Brooks hits this uppishly towards deep cover-point and takes a couple of runs.
Serves this full and outside off, Shamarh Brooks works this towards point.
Mitchell Santner serves this a fraction short and angling into the left-hander. Shimron Hetmyer clips this towards deep square leg for a single.

Dropped! But that was an amazing effort from Ish Sodhi! Lockie Ferguson bangs this in a fraction short and angling down leg. Shamarh Brooks pulls this to the left of short fine leg. Ish Sodhi put his hand out while diving and manages to stop the ball that looked like it had gone past him. He can not hold on to it but has definitely saved a certain boundary.
WIDE! Shorter and bowled down leg once again. The umpire indicates it is wide once again.
WIDE! Lockie Ferguson bowls this on a good length but straying down leg, Shamarh Brooks looks to work this fine and misses. Is called wide by the umpire.
Serves this on a good length and just outside off. Really quick and gets the outside edge of Shimron Hetmyer's bat as it runs away towards third man for a single.
A fraction short once again and angles into the stumps, Shamarh Brooks looks to pull and misses. The ball rolls off the thigh pad towards short fine leg as they take a leg bye.

Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Shamarh Brooks works this towards point and looks for a single. There is a dive and a stop and Shimron Hetmyer sends him back. The throw is probably at the wrong end as Shamarh Brooks was the one who was in trouble.
Lockie Ferguson serves this full and just outside off, Shamarh Brooks fends this back towards the bowler.
Shimron Hetmyer walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Just like that West Indies have lost their third! Lockie Ferguson strikes with his first delivery. He bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Devon Thomas looks to pull this and gets a top edge that flies towards fine leg. Ish Sodhi at short fine leg runs back and takes an easy catch. West Indies have been playing around with their batting lineup and it does not seem to be working for them.
Commentary.Howout: c Ish Sodhi b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: Lockie Ferguson has been brought in the attack.
On off, defended out on the deck.
Tossed up, on the pads. Thomas tickles it to short fine leg for a quick single.
Tossed up on middle, nudged to square leg.
Angles a length ball on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Slightly shorter again on middle. Brooks works it to square leg.
Devon Thomas makes his way out to the middle. West Indies need to be careful not to lose too many wickets in their hunt for quick runs.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pooran will not be happy with this one! It was clearly there to be hit but the extra bounce doesn't help him! Shorter and outside off. Pooran clears his front leg and looks to pull but it goes slightly from the higher part of the blade and to deep mid-wicket where Glenn Phillips comes forward and takes it. Good start by Mitchell Santner.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: Mitchell Santner has been brought into the attack.
On a length and outside off, slower ball. Brooks looks to push with soft hands but misses.
SIX! BANG! On a length and on middle. Brooks steps across and heaves it high over deep square leg for a biggie.
Short of a length and on off, pulled past mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
On middle. Pooran punches it to mid on and takes a quick single.
FOUR MORE! Too straight this time on the pads. Pooran just helps it away over short fine leg for a boundary.
SIX! Lovely pick up shot! On a length and outside off. Pooran hits it flat to long on and it lands right on the ropes for a six.
Leg bye! Slanting on the pads. Pooran misses his flick and it rolls to short fine leg for a leg bye.
Full and on off. Blocked to covers.
An in-swinging yorker, outside off. Brooks drives it to mid off. Boult comes in middle of the running Pooran but no harm done in the end.
Tries a bouncer now on middle. Brooks sits under it.
Angles a length ball, outside off. Brooks mistimes his slap to covers.
On a length and on middle. Brooks taps it to covers.
Too full and on off, it is hit to covers.
FOUR! Another inswinger but this is slightly full and on off. Pooran punches it as he shows the full face of the bat, towards mid off for a boundary.
Nicholas Pooran the captain of West Indies makes his way out the middle. It is probably to keep the left-right combination going.

OUT! LBW! Mayers goes! Sharp movement for Southee and he gets his reward. This is full and around middle and leg, it lands and swings back into the left-hander. Kyle Mayers is too late as he tries to flick but misses and gets rapped on the pads. An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Mayers reviews it though. No bat there. Ball Tracking shows it is umpire's call on wickets hitting.
On a length and outside off, pushed through point for one.
Leg bye! Length ball on middle and swinging on the pads. Mayers looks to flick but gets squared up and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but that was going down. A leg bye.
Length and on top of off, punched to mid off.
Wide! A length ball, down the leg side, gets to swing more away. Mayers looks to pull but misses.
Tim Southee to start from the other end.
Trent Boult serves this full and outside off, Shamarh Brooks solid in defence as he fends the ball towards the cover fielder.

FOUR! Second boundary of the over! Shamarh Brooks goes really full and in line with the stumps, Shamarh Brooks uses his wrists and flicks this uppishly to the left of the divind mid-wicket fielder. He does not get to it and runs away to the deep mid-wicket fence for four more runs.
Trent Boult goes full once again and outside off, Shamarh Brooks strokes this towards cover.

FOUR! This has been out away! Trent Boult pulls his length back once again and serves this outside off, Shamarh Brooks gets on his toes and cuts this past the point fielder. The ball races away to the deep point fence and West Indies get their first boundary.

Trent Boult serves this fuller and outside off, Shamarh Brooks hits this straight over the bowler's head. Trent Boult gets a hand to it and the ball runs past the mid off fielder. Good work from Tim Southee as he gives chase and stops the ball to restrict the batters to a brace.
Trent Boult begins with a back-of-a-length delivery angled into the batter, Kyle Mayers pulls the ball towards deep backward square leg for a single.
